name: Finance - Weekly Band Renewal Main Review
contract_reason: Main wake to review the weekly renewal packet and surface it to Randall; approval card when the gate stops.
description: Wakes Main 30 minutes after the weekly band renewal to review the packet and surface it to Randall.

payload.text: Weekly band renewal, thesis review and recommendation review. (1) Read tmp/weekly-band-renewal.json and .md (check started_at_utc is from today; if stale or missing, report the job as not run). If status=applied: verify the guard step passed, then send Randall a short Telegram report of what changed (largest edge moves, floor-widened, repaired days, new expiry) with the rollback record path. If status=needs_owner_review: send an approval card listing each gate reason and affected names with your recommendation; do not apply without his reply. If status=apply_failed: P1, do not retry, report step tails. (2) Read tmp/thesis-review.json (generated today). For each new_quarter or review_overdue flag, draft an updated thesis version for Randall's acceptance (keep prior version in history); for missing_thesis, propose the next 3-5 names to draft. (3) Read tmp/recommendation-funnel.json (generated today): present review candidates with score, band position, conviction, macro fit, relative strength and earnings flags, plus board-only names with their reasons, as non-executing recommendations for Randall's review. Never accept a thesis, change scope, methodology, weights, or anything outside state/finance/standing-approvals/band-renewal-option-b.json on your own; no capital, order, account or execution language.

contract_update_reason: Payload extended to weekly recommendation review (funnel-v1 approved 2026-09-23).
